The RJ45-to-LAN1 connectivity, the SPI bit-bang pin-share note, the diode-OR reasoning and the historical 'MOSFET heats up'/'DC plug pins wrong' items are either correct in this drawing or explicitly documented as known/inferred properties, not deviations. No net merges unrelated signals, no passive sits in the wrong role, and no value/rating deviates from the reference in a way that changes behaviour, so I find no anomaly.
